description: The line plot illustrates the comparison between initial and final accuracy as a function of o_pop frequency, measured in units of 10^4. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and is linear, with tick labels at intervals of 2, ranging from 1 to 19. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and is linear, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot features two lines: the green line represents initial accuracy, and the blue line represents final accuracy. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 at an o_pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 0.8 at an o_pop frequency of 5, and ends at an accuracy of about 0.4 at an o_pop frequency of 19. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.6 at an o_pop frequency of 1, peaks at around 0.9 at an o_pop frequency of 5, and ends at an accuracy of about 0.8 at an o_pop frequency of 19. Both lines show variability, indicated by error bars, and the final accuracy line is consistently above the initial accuracy line throughout the plot.
